svg.title: ADE capability responsibility and simplified dataflow map
svg.desc: Four capability domains, supporting and adjacent registers; select a module in the accompanying HTML for source references and all flow boundaries.

g.text: Domain -> Subsystem -> Module = L1 / L2 / L3 ownership, not execution depth.
Blue: recall and respond. Green: review and retain. Records are not processing modules.

g.title: Curated tool choice and result use
g.text: Curated tool choice and result use
Existing compaction stays MEM-09. MEM-10 alone reserves an additional optional view.
Supporting register / shared machinery, outside the four capability domains
Adjacent features / retain their existing owners
Simplified main loop; HTML exposes all named edges in three views. Input capture precedes generation; finalization stays atomic.
Reviewed 2026-10-04 / source f98c0ec6c78f. Status describes code scope, not semantic acceptance or release.
